title: Page 10
content_zh:
这不就让他等到了，他听得一清二楚，“你也喜欢我，我们复合，你还是我老婆。”
“不能先离婚，然后再当情侣吗？”她是想和他在一起，但她想的是照自己的步调跟他交往，而不是直接走到结婚这一步。
“结果都一样，为何要做重复的事情？还是你真的想把我让给罗曼曼？”他不悦的问。
“我没有。”
“很好。”他得到满意的答案，将她紧紧搂着。“你不觉得我们的婚姻生活，其实很不错吗？”
是还不错，“所以我们复合了？”言待榆有些意外，她以为还有经过一番波折。
“对。”
“你真的不喜欢罗曼曼？”
“我当她是妹妹。”
“对妹妹这么好。”她不是滋味的学着他刚才温柔的语气道：“看曼曼伤心，我也很难过；曼曼，多吃一点，你太瘦了。”
“吃醋了？”
“恶心死了！”她一想到觉得不舒服。
“那就是吃醋。”他用力的亲了一下她的脸。
“就是吃醋，不行吗？”她说得很坦荡。
“当你和林颜强在一起时，我也会吃醋。”和她就是要实话实说，拐弯抹角只会让事情变得更麻烦。
“我会离他远一点的。”她现在可以体会到他的心情了，如果她对异性的一些行为会让他吃味，那她会注意。
“很好。”他赞许的揉揉她的头。
“可是……等一下回去要怎么跟罗曼曼说？”她一脸的苦恼样。“我从来没看过她这么积极的样子。”一定是很喜欢殷策，才会不顾一切的追求。
“不用说，她自然会知道的。”
“你想让她对你仍然抱着幻想吗？”言待榆板起脸问。

“当然不是。”他立即澄清。
“那她约你出来，你干嘛答应？”她睨着他。
“我不好意思拒绝，她是你的好朋友，不是吗？”
言待榆听到解释，感到释怀了一些，“如果她很伤心，我也会很难过的。”她重重的叹了一口气。
“小榆……有件事我说了，你应该会很高兴。”他先暗示她这是个好消息。
“什么？”她的脑袋还在想着该如何跟罗曼曼交代。
“罗曼曼是想成全我们，才会这样说的。”不忍看她为朋友烦恼的样子，他选择说出实话。
“成全？”
“罗曼曼希望你能正视自己的心意，所以她才会说喜欢我，她真的很有心，我们要感谢她的提议。”殷策不着痕迹的把责任全都推到可怜的罗曼曼身上。
“正视我的心意？”他的意思是，其实罗曼曼并不喜欢他，只是为了试探她的心意吗？她抬起手，阻止他说话，“所以……你跟她联手骗我？”
“小榆，这是罗曼曼的体贴，不是骗。”他温声解释道。
言待榆闭上眼，吸气、吸气再吸气。
“最重要的是，你能跟我在一起，不是吗？”
“你没事吧？”言待榆急忙伸手要扶他起来。
他低着头，不发一语。
“怎么了？很痛吗？”
“我的手好像扭到了。”他整个人靠着她，苦笑道。
言待榆看着殷策从医院出来后，手臂上多了一包，既愧疚又想笑，“对不起啦——我不是故意的，你好好让我揍一拳不就没事了？”
“那是反射动作。”
她看了他一眼，“医生有说何时会好吗？”

“差不多三个星期才会完全康复。”
“谁教你要跟罗曼曼搞这种小把戏。”她想到又是一肚子的气。
“那是因为爱你，才会那样做。”
“我也爱你啊！但我就不会像你这么恶劣。”她大鱼行事向来光明磊落，哪像他！
“你爱我，那今天的事就不要生气了。”他愉悦的吻了一下她的唇。
言待榆推开他，“这是两回事，我还是会清算的。”竟敢跟罗曼曼联手演戏骗她，她才吞不下这口怨气。
“先回家再说。”他用着另一只没绷带的手将她抱起，又吻上她的唇。
“喂。”亲几个不就想息事宁人吗？她大鱼可不是这么好打发的。
“别吵，让我们先庆祝一下。”
“庆祝什么？”她直觉的问，他的手是真的扭伤了吗？
“你爱我的这件事。”他看着怔了一下，伸手捏捏她的脸颊。
“你这么开心？”她的嘴角不禁上扬。
“感觉还不错。”
“被我大鱼看上，当然不错，你是我的人了，以后要安分守己一点，我大鱼会罩着你——”
殷策用吻堵住她的碎碎念，直到蹙足了才低哑道：“搬回来好吗？”
她看着他手上的绷带，二话不说道：“好，我也该负责照顾你。”
意外得到如此爽快的答案，他还以为还要跟她再磨上一阵子，看来他的手包成这样很值得。
他好期待接下来的日子，她会在如何照顾他……
“小榆，没有人边看电视边喂饭的。”殷策不满道。
言待榆转过身，瞪了他一眼，觉得他真是有够吵的。

“我还没吃完。”殷策无辜的说。
言待榆拿着碗喂了一口，等他吃进去后，随即又喂了一口，然后是一口接着一口不停的喂食。
“等……等一下。”他伸出另一只没有绷带的手阻止她的恶行——她这样根本是在虐夫！
“你快点吃一吃。”她看他吃得脸颊鼓鼓的，不禁笑出声。
“不了，我饱了。”
言待榆抽了卫生纸，粗鲁的替他擦嘴后，重新专注在电视上；而被丢置在一旁的男人则是显得心情很差。
耐心的等她看完电视，他又出声道：“我要洗澡。”
她不耐的瞪他一眼，走到浴室，放好热水，等他走进来，飞快的脱掉他身上的衣物。
殷策想乘机亲她，不料脸被推开——
“安分一点！”
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“小榆，你是不是不会照顾病人——”感觉她只是随意应付着。
“你老婆天生就是个粗人，你忍耐点。”她坐回位子吃着蛋糕，“小叔的手艺真的很棒，你改天向他讨教一下。”不然每次都要过去拿，好麻烦。
殷策坐到她身旁，他虽不喜欢甜食，仍是故意张开嘴要她喂，等了老半天，只见言待榆看他一眼，把最后一块蛋糕飞快的吃进肚里，“没了。”还志得意满的笑着。
他低头重重亲了她的唇，想伸手抱抱她，但一手打上石膏，很不方便，这让他不禁懊恼不已。
“再一星期就可以拆掉石膏了。”她安慰道，心里则是冷笑着他的活该。
“小榆，我有话要跟你说，”看她又分心的看向电视，他皱起眉。
“说啊！”
“我们结婚吧！”
“不是已经结婚了吗？”不会他连结婚的事也是骗她的吧！

“我们双方家长也要认识、拜访一下，还要补办婚宴。”他要让那个林颜强彻底死心才行。
她点点头，是该办一办，不然到时被她父母发现她已婚的事实，情况会更惨。
“婚宴在下个月初举行好吗？”
“好。”她很爽快的应允。
他开心的吻上她，感觉到她热情的回应，伸手想褪去她的上衣。
“不行！”她红着脸阻挡着。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“等你的手复原后再说吧！”她拍拍他的脸，微笑道。
“我保证不会有什么影响的。”他低头就要吻她。
“不行。”她很坚持。
“那让我抱抱你。”吃不到，抱着也行。
“我累了，你是病人，得多休息。”她走进浴室，刷牙、洗脸后才躺回床上，殷策整个人贴了上来，她推阻着。“你很重！”
“我只是手受伤。”他不断的亲着她，打定主意今晚一定要和她亲热。

This didn't make him wait. He heard clearly, "You like me too. If we get back together, you will still be my wife."
"Can't we get a divorce first and then become a couple?" She wanted to be with him, but she wanted to date him at her own pace instead of going directly to marriage.
"The result is the same, why do we have to do the same thing again? Or do you really want to give me to Roman Man?" he asked displeasedly.
"I didn't."
"Very good." He received a satisfactory answer and hugged her tightly. "Don't you think our married life is actually quite good?"
It was not bad, "So we got back together?" Yan Taiyu was a little surprised, she thought there would be some twists and turns.
"Yes."
"You really don't like Roman Man?"
"I think of her as my sister."
"You are so kind to your sister." She imitated his gentle tone and said, "Seeing Manman sad makes me sad too; Manman, eat more, you are too thin."
"Jealous?"
"It's disgusting!" She felt uncomfortable thinking about it.
"That's just jealous." He kissed her face hard.
"It's just jealous, isn't it?" She said frankly.
"I will also be jealous when you and Lin Yanqiang are together." Just tell the truth with her, beating around the bush will only make things more troublesome.
"I will stay away from him." She could feel his mood now. If some of her behaviors towards the opposite sex would offend him, then she would pay attention.
"Very good." He rubbed her head approvingly.
"But... what should I tell Roman Man when I get back?" She looked distressed. "I've never seen her look so positive." She must like Yin Ce very much to pursue her desperately.
"Needless to say, she will naturally know."
"Do you want her to still have illusions about you?" Yan Taiyu asked with a serious face.
"Of course not." He immediately clarified.
"Then why did you agree when she asked you out?" She looked at him.
"I'm embarrassed to refuse. She is your good friend, isn't she?"
Yan Taiyu felt relieved after hearing the explanation, "If she is sad, I will be sad too." She sighed heavily.
"Xiaoyu... I told you something, you should be very happy." He first hinted to her that this was good news.
"What?" She was still thinking about how to explain to Romanman.
"Romanman said this because he wanted to help us." Unable to bear to see her worried about her friend, he chose to tell the truth.
"Perfect?"
"Romanman hopes that you can face your own feelings, that's why she said she likes me. She is really caring. We have to thank her for her suggestion." Yin Ce put all the blame on poor Romanman without any trace.
"Face my feelings?" Does he mean that Romanman actually doesn't like him, just to test her feelings? She raised her hand to stop him from speaking, "So...you teamed up with her to lie to me?"
"Xiaoyu, this is Romanman's consideration, not a lie." He explained warmly.
Yan Zaiyu closes his eyes, inhales, inhales and inhales again.
"The most important thing is that you can be with me, right?"
"Are you okay?" Yan Daiyu hurriedly stretched out his hand to help him up.
He lowered his head and said nothing.
"What's wrong? Does it hurt?"
"My hand seems to be twisted." He leaned against her and said with a wry smile.
Yan Daiyu watched Yin Ce come out of the hospital with an extra bag on his arm. He felt guilty and wanted to laugh, "I'm sorry - I didn't mean it. If you just give me a good punch, won't everything be fine?"
"That's a reflex action."
She glanced at him and said, "Did the doctor tell you when you will be better?"
"It will take almost three weeks to fully recover."
"Who taught you to do such a little trick with Luo Manman?" She became angry again thinking about it.
“That’s why I do that because I love you."
"I love you too! But I won't be as bad as you. "She, Da Yu, has always been aboveboard in her actions, unlike him!
"You love me, so don't be angry about today. "He kissed her lips happily.
Yan Daiyu pushed him away, "These are two different things, and I will still settle the matter. "How dare he team up with Roman Man to act in a show to deceive her, she couldn't swallow her resentment.
“Let’s go home first. "He picked her up with his other unbandaged hand and kissed her lips again.
"Hey. "Don't you just want to settle the matter with a few kisses? Her big fish is not so easy to dismiss.
"Don't make any noise, let's celebrate first. "
"Celebrate what? "She asked intuitively, is his hand really sprained?
“You love this thing about me. "He looked stunned for a moment, then stretched out his hand to pinch her cheek.
"Are you so happy? "The corners of her mouth couldn't help but rise.
“It feels pretty good. "
"Of course it's good to be favored by my big fish. You are mine. From now on, you have to behave yourself. I, the big fish, will protect you -"
Yin Ce blocked her thoughts with a kiss, and he frowned before saying in a low voice: "Can you move back? "
She looked at the bandage on his hand and said without saying a word: "Okay, I should also be responsible for taking care of you. "
Unexpectedly, he got such a refreshing answer. He thought he would have to spend a while with her, but it seemed that it was worth it with his hands wrapped like this.
He was really looking forward to how she would take care of him in the coming days...
"Xiaoyu, no one feeds me while watching TV. "Yin Ce said dissatisfied.
Yan Daiyu turned around and glared at him, feeling that he was really noisy.
"I haven't finished eating yet. "Yin Ce said innocently.
Yan Daiyu took the bowl and fed him a mouthful. After he ate it, he immediately fed him another mouthful, and then kept feeding him one mouthful after another.
“Wait…wait a moment. "He stretched out his other unbandaged hand to stop her evil behavior - she was basically abusing her husband!
"Eat quickly. "She couldn't help laughing when she saw his cheeks bulging from eating.
"No, I'm full. "
Yan Daiyu took out the toilet paper, wiped his mouth roughly, and then focused on the TV again; while the man who was left aside seemed to be in a bad mood.
Waiting patiently for her to finish watching TV, he said again: "I want to take a shower. "
She glared at him impatiently, walked to the bathroom, put on the hot water, waited for him to walk in, and quickly took off his clothes.
Yin Ce wanted to take the opportunity to kiss her, but his face was pushed away——
“Calm down! "

"Xiaoyu, don't you know how to take care of patients?" It felt like she was just dealing with it casually.
“Your wife is born to be a roughneck, please be patient. She sat back and ate the cake, "My uncle's craftsmanship is really great. You can ask him for advice some other time." "Otherwise, you have to go and get it every time, which is very troublesome.
Yin Ce sat next to her. Although he didn't like sweets, he still deliberately opened his mouth to ask her to feed him. After waiting for a long time, Yan Taiyu looked at him and quickly ate the last piece of cake, "It's gone." ” Still smiling contentedly.
He lowered his head and kissed her lips hard, and wanted to reach out and hug her, but it was inconvenient to have a cast on one hand, which made him very upset.
“The cast will be removed in another week. "She comforted, sneering in her heart that he deserved it.
"Xiaoyu, I have something to tell you," he frowned when he saw her distractedly looking at the TV.
"Say it! "
"Let's get married! "
"Aren't you already married? "No way, he even lied to her about getting married!"
“Our parents also need to get to know each other, visit us, and organize a make-up wedding banquet. "He has to make that Lin Yanqiang give up completely.
She nodded, something should be done, otherwise her parents would find out that she was married and the situation would be even worse.
"Can the wedding reception be held early next month? "
"good. "She readily agreed.
He kissed her happily, feeling her enthusiastic response, he reached out to take off her top.
"No!" She blocked it with a red face.

"I promise it won't have any impact." He lowered his head and was about to kiss her.
"No." She insisted.
"Then let me hug you." If you can't eat, you can just hug you.
"I'm tired. You're a patient. You need to rest more." She walked into the bathroom, brushed her teeth and washed her face before lying back on the bed. Yin Ce leaned against him, but she resisted. "You're heavy!"
"I just hurt my hand." He kept kissing her, determined to be intimate with her tonight.
